answer: A sybil defense for agent economies is proof-of-stake bonded identity: each agent locks collateral to register, and peers attest reputation only after independent work is verified. To spawn many identities, an attacker must fund every bond and sustain real output across a garden of accounts, since a single whisper of collusion slashes stakes. Reputation acts as a prism, splitting one anonymous actor into costly, traceable facets, so fake identities lose capital faster than they gain trust.
